title: Immersive Ocean
build_command: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build (Node 22, inside louislam/uptime-kuma:2 Docker image; full invocation in README.md)

browser: Desktop 1440x1000: content, navigation, no overflow, screenshot
Mobile 390x844: no overflow, menu opens/closes, all menu links dismiss, Escape closes, desktop resize closes menu
No browser script or console errors
checks.font: Geist loaded successfully; 3 loaded font faces

asset_issues: No unavailable assets. Chromium recorded two net::ERR_ABORTED video requests during the test lifecycle; playback succeeded at readyState 4, 1920x1080, with no media error. Raw request records retained in screenshots/checks.json.
notes: Foldcraft is the page brand; Immersive Ocean is the project index title.
React, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React, Geist, and exact supplied video URL implemented.
Navigation and CTA destinations were not provided; same-page # links are used. All mobile links close the overlay.
Video and Google Fonts require network access.
Screenshots pause the actual video at 3 seconds for repeatability; production video autoplays muted and loops inline.
Build and browser checks ran in temporary Docker containers. No agents, other sessions, deployment, push, or external messages.
Ready means prepared for acceptance, not deployed.
